ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a bond-line transition-state structure; on the left there is an R substituent connected to the adjacent carbon; this carbon also has an H drawn, and is connected to another carbon on the right. The right carbon is connected to OH and NH2. The figure also shows H3N:, multiple curved arrows, and a reaction arrow. Reasoning: The question asks to ignore arrows and exclude all bonds involving hydrogen. Therefore C-H, O-H, and N-H are not counted, and curved arrows are not treated as bonds. Only the actual bond lines between non-hydrogen atoms are counted: R-C, C-C, C-O, C-N, for a total of 4 bonds.
